description: Organes de coupure du réseau de transport électrique 400 kV is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Infos-Réseaux.com. This dataset represents the position of the HTB power shut-offs present on the 400 kV network only of RTE and operated by the carrier. Coverage: Infos-Réseaux.com. The portal shows the English title as "Shut-offs of the electric transmission network 400 kV" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Infos-Réseaux.com. Its keywords include 400-kv, interrupteurs, energie, reseaux, reseaux-energie, infrastructure. The listing shows 1 download or service links in GEOJSON. The listing shows 2020-02-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
